scripts.dev:api: node -e "try{process.loadEnvFile('.env')}catch{}; require('child_process').execSync('npm run dev --workspace=@bigola/api', { stdio: 'inherit', env: process.env });"
scripts.dev:worker: node -e "try{process.loadEnvFile('.env')}catch{}; require('child_process').execSync('npm run dev:worker --workspace=@bigola/api', { stdio: 'inherit', env: process.env });"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@bigola/shared && npm run build --workspace=@bigola/api && npm run build --workspace=@bigola/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@bigola/shared && npm run test --workspace=@bigola/api
scripts.test:cloud: node -e "try{process.loadEnvFile('.env')}catch{}; if(process.env.NODE_ENV==='production'){throw new Error('Refusing cloud tests against production');} process.env.RUN_INFRA_TESTS='true'; require('child_process').execSync('npm run test --workspace=@bigola/api', { stdio: 'inherit', env: process.env });"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@bigola/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@bigola/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@bigola/web
scripts.db:migrate: node -e "try{process.loadEnvFile('.env')}catch{}; require('child_process').execSync('npm run db:migrate --workspace=@bigola/api', { stdio: 'inherit', env: process.env });"
scripts.db:seed: node -e "try{process.loadEnvFile('.env')}catch{}; require('child_process').execSync('npm run db:seed --workspace=@bigola/api', { stdio: 'inherit', env: process.env });"
scripts.bootstrap:owner: node -e "try{process.loadEnvFile('.env')}catch{}; require('child_process').execSync('npm run bootstrap:owner --workspace=@bigola/api', { stdio: 'inherit', env: process.env });"
scripts.health:remote: node -e "try{process.loadEnvFile('.env')}catch{}; const url = process.env.API_HEALTH_URL || 'http://localhost:4000/api/v1/health'; fetch(url).then(async r => { console.log(r.status, await r.text()); if(!r.ok) process.exit(1); }).catch(e => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); });"
